notes: This phase changes the v2 display compilation unit from Activity cards to one Person track with one identity label and one or more historical Activity/placement segments.
Canonical Activities remain separate historical records; the track layer does not merge or rewrite them.
Unresolved Activities remain explicit and never receive invented coordinates merely to keep a Person renderable.
The opposes relation is retained and flagged as a counterparty relation here; Phase 6 will exclude it from primary Person placement while preserving it as an overlay.
The production v1 renderer remains authoritative until the later v2 renderer cutover.
